summary: Reference-only: Magic action while held spends 1–3 of 10 charges for a 30-foot Cone.
text: Reference-only: Magic action while held spends 1–3 of 10 charges for a 30-foot Cone. DC 15 Dexterity: 1d8 Piercing per charge and Poisoned until your next turn starts on failure; half damage only on success. Regain 1d10 charges each dawn; spending the last destroys it on a d20 result of 1.
